questions.q: Which law describes the change of direction of light between two media?
questions.why: n₁ sin θ₁ = n₂ sin θ₂.

questions.q: What is the index of the glass of the refractometer?
questions.why: The stone must have a lower index for the test to work.

questions.q: Beyond the critical angle, the light is…
choices: entirely sent back into the glass (total reflection)

questions.q: How many shadow edges do you see on an anisotropic stone?
questions.why: An isotropic stone has only one.

questions.q: In which order do you put the liquid and the stone?
choices: The drop of liquid first, the stone after
The stone first, then the drop
questions.why: The contact drop fills the gap between the glass and the stone.

questions.q: What does the position of the shadow edge on the scale give?
questions.why: The border between the bright zone and the dark zone.

questions.q: A stone with an index higher than that of the glass (1.81)…
choices: cannot be measured with the refractometer
questions.why: The reading goes out of the range of the prism.

questions.q: What do you note on an anisotropic stone?
choices: The extreme values: nα, nβ, nγ
questions.why: The shadow edges move when the lens is turned.
